item.title: Regulator proposes new rules for pet supplement labelling
item.description: The Example Standards Agency has opened consultation on a rule that would require every supplement sold for animals to list ingredient amounts per serving and to cite the study behind any efficacy claim on the label. The agency says it has reviewed 212 products and found claims on 140 of them it could not match to a published trial.

item.title: City council votes to replace parking meters with app-only payment
item.description:
Example City's council voted 7 to 2 to remove all 3,400 coin and card parking meters by March and move payment to a single phone app.

The council's own report notes that 18 percent of residents over 65 do not own a smartphone. A cash option "may be considered" at a later date.

item.title: Startup claims its AI cut cloud bills by 90 percent
item.description: Example Optimizer Inc. says its agent reduced one customer's monthly cloud spend from $400,000 to $40,000 in six weeks. The company declined to name the customer, and the figure comes from its own press release. No independent benchmark has been published.
